fixes.quote: Clash of Clans freebies and Store Specials
site_specific: Server-render the gift/freebies content for /clashofclans-gift and its locale variants instead of relying on the client-side __NEXT_DATA__ bundle alone.
Ship at least the offer heading and a short description in the initial HTML response so a non-executing fetcher sees more than 'Skip to content'.

fixes.quote: Supercell Makers of Hay Day, Clash of Clans, Boom Beach, Clash Royale, Brawl Stars, Squad Busters and mo.co.
site_specific: Add Organization JSON-LD to the homepage naming Supercell as the maker of Hay Day, Clash of Clans, Boom Beach, Clash Royale, Brawl Stars, Squad Busters and mo.co.
Include a sameAs array linking Supercell's official social profiles and Wikipedia entry so an assistant can disambiguate the brand.

fixes.quote: Clash of Clans freebies and Store Specials
site_specific: Wrap 'Clash of Clans freebies and Store Specials' in a top-level heading element on the gift page instead of leaving the page with no h1 at all.

fixes.quote: Sorry, but the page or file you were trying to access does not exist.
site_specific: Return an HTTP 404 status code for the /404 route itself, instead of HTTP 200 with the 'Page not found' text as the body.
Keep the 'Sorry, but the page or file you were trying to access does not exist.' copy, just pair it with the correct status code.

fixes.quote: Supercell is a game company based in Helsinki, Finland, with offices in San Francisco, Seoul, Shanghai, and London.
site_specific: Add Organization JSON-LD to /en/about-us stating Supercell is based in Helsinki, Finland with offices in San Francisco, Seoul, Shanghai, and London.
Include foundingDate and numberOfEmployees where the page already states them in text.

verdicts.explanation: This URL is the site's not-found page; its short text is the expected error message, not a failed content page.
The homepage's JSON-LD carries no sameAs links, matching the finding: nothing anchors the Supercell brand to an external profile.
All four pages with a missing title are already reported by B4_empty_shell as essentially empty HTML shells; the blank title is the same underlying defect, not a separate one.
The raw HTML of the affected pages sets user-scalable=no in the viewport meta tag, confirming pinch-zoom is suppressed as the finding states.
